items.prompt: A certified evaluation interval contains zero. What should a bracket update do?

options.text: Pick whichever sign produces a shorter-looking computation
options.why: An uncertain sign cannot support the bracket proof.

options.text: Treat the midpoint as an exact root
options.why: An interval containing zero is not an exact equality.

options.text: Suppress the uncertainty and report converged
Refine evaluation or report an indeterminate-sign state
options.why: Do not discard a half based on an unestablished sign.

items.explanation: The invariant depends on reliable signs. Estimated accuracy and certified sign bounds are different contracts.
